facts.text: Caroline attended an LGBTQ support group on the day before the session, which she described as powerful.

evidence.quote: I went to a LGBTQ support group yesterday and it was so powerful.
Wow, that's cool, Caroline! What happened that was so awesome? Did you hear any inspiring stories?

facts.text: Caroline mentioned that the transgender stories shared at the LGBTQ support group were particularly inspiring.

evidence.quote: The transgender stories were so inspiring! I was so happy and thankful for all the support.

facts.text: Caroline shared an image of a dog walking past a wall with a painting of a woman during the session.
